info.name: Factset Analytics Datastore About Financial Statements API
info.description:
Allow clients to fetch precalculated Analytics through predeterministic URLs.

Contact Support:
 Name: FactSet Research Systems
 Email: api@factset.com

query.description: (Required) The requested list of security identifiers. Accepted ID types include Market Tickers, SEDOL, ISINs, CUSIPs, or FactSet Permanent Ids. Limit of 1,000 per non-batch request / 2,000 per batch request (GET) or 30,000 per batch request (POST).

(Required) Requested list of Financial Statement Items or Ratios. Use the `/metrics` endpoint for a complete list of available FF_* metric items. When requesting multiple metrics, you cannot mix metric data types (e.g. strings and floats). Limit of 1,600 per request.

Periodicity or frequency of the fiscal periods. ANN = Annual Original, ANN_R = Annual Latest (includes restatements), QTR = Quarterly Original, QTR_R = Quarterly Latest, SEMI = Semi-Annual, SEMI_R = Semi-Annual Latest, LTM = Last Twelve Months, LTM_R = Last Twelve Months Latest, LTMSG = Last Twelve Months Global, LTM_SEMI = Last Twelve Months Semi-Annual, YTD = Year-to-date.
The fiscal period start expressed as YYYY-MM-DD. Calendar date that will fall back to the most recent completed period during resolution.
The fiscal period end expressed as YYYY-MM-DD. Calendar date that will fall back to the most recently completed period during resolution.
Currency code for currency values. For a list of currency ISO codes, visit Online Assistant Page 1470. Use "DOC" for reporting currency. Defaults to LOCAL.
Update status flag. RP = Include preliminary data, RF = Only final data.

Enables asynchronous batch processing, supporting long-running requests up to 20 minutes. Upon requesting batch=Y, the service will respond with HTTP 202. Use batch-status to check completion and batch-result to retrieve results.

request.description:
Retrieves FactSet Fundamental standardized data for specified securities. Use the `/metrics` endpoint to retrieve a full list of valid metrics or data items.

The `/fundamentals` endpoint currently supports Long Running asynchronous requests up to **20 minutes** via batch parameter. Id limits are increased to 2000 ids per request when using batch capability. This 2000 id limit has been derived based on single metric for one day.

response.name: Fundamental data items returned successfully.

item.name: Factset Returns Company Fundamental Data for a List of Identifiers.

request.description:
Retrieves FactSet Fundamental standardized data for specified securities using a POST request body. Use the `/metrics` endpoint to retrieve a full list of valid metrics or data items.

The `/fundamentals` endpoint currently supports Long Running asynchronous requests up to **20 minutes** via batch parameter. Id limits are increased to 30,000 ids per request when using batch capability. This 30,000 id limit has been derived based on single metric for one day.

item.name: Factset Returns Financial Statement Line Items.

query.description: (Required) The requested list of security identifiers. Accepted ID types include Market Tickers, SEDOL, ISINs, CUSIPs, or FactSet Permanent Ids. Limit of 1,000 per non-batch request / 2,000 per batch request (GET) or 30,000 per batch request (POST).

(Required) Requested list of Financial Statement Items or Ratios. Use the `/metrics` endpoint for a complete list of available FF_* metric items. When requesting multiple metrics, you cannot mix metric data types (e.g. strings and floats). Limit of 1,600 per request.

Filter financial statements by type. INCOME_STATEMENT for revenue and earnings data, BALANCE_SHEET for assets and liabilities, CASH_FLOW for cash flow activities, FINANCIAL_SERVICES for financial institution specific items.

Periodicity or frequency of the fiscal periods. ANN = Annual Original, ANN_R = Annual Latest (includes restatements), QTR = Quarterly Original, QTR_R = Quarterly Latest, SEMI = Semi-Annual, SEMI_R = Semi-Annual Latest, LTM = Last Twelve Months, LTM_R = Last Twelve Months Latest, LTMSG = Last Twelve Months Global, LTM_SEMI = Last Twelve Months Semi-Annual, YTD = Year-to-date.
The fiscal period start expressed as YYYY-MM-DD. Calendar date that will fall back to the most recent completed period during resolution.
The fiscal period end expressed as YYYY-MM-DD. Calendar date that will fall back to the most recently completed period during resolution.
Currency code for currency values. For a list of currency ISO codes, visit Online Assistant Page 1470. Use "DOC" for reporting currency. Defaults to LOCAL.
Update status flag. RP = Include preliminary data, RF = Only final data.

request.description:
Retrieves detailed financial statement data organized by statement type (income statement, balance sheet, cash flow). Use the `category` parameter to filter by statement type, and the `metrics` parameter to request specific line items.

Available statement categories include INCOME_STATEMENT, BALANCE_SHEET, CASH_FLOW, and FINANCIAL_SERVICES for financial institutions.

response.name: Financial statement data returned successfully.
